svg.title: Startup Capital: Preserve Cash Before Expanding Equipment
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-stack; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Startup Capital: Preserve Cash Before Expanding Equipment; subtitle: Four buckets total $150,000 within the $75,000–$350,000 range.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values encode the $150,000 reference allocation in USD. Details also provide complete $75,000 lean and $350,000 expanded allocations. Startup capital is funding capacity, not revenue or an immediate operating expense.; caption: Lean: $25,000 + $20,000 + $10,000 + $20,000 = $75,000. Reference: $60,000 + $40,000 + $20,000 + $30,000 = $150,000. Expanded: $150,000 + $90,000 + $40,000 + $70,000 = $350,000.; stages: label: Working-capital reserve; value: $60,000 reference allocation; 40.0%; numeric value: 60000.0; detail: Lean $25,000; reference $60,000; expanded $150,000. Fund receivable delays and job commitments. At $42,500 monthly Base operating costs, $60,000 covers about 1.41 months before variable direct job costs.; label: Mitigation equipment; value: $40,000 reference allocation; 26.7%; numeric value: 40000.0; detail: Lean $20,000; reference $40,000; expanded $90,000. Prioritize extraction, air movement, dehumidification, moisture meters, protective equipment, and calibrated measurement tools; rent overflow capacity.; label: Vehicle and mobilization setup; value: $20,000 reference allocation; 13.3%; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Lean $10,000; reference $20,000; expanded $40,000. Fund vehicle deposits or acquisitions, secure storage, load restraint, and initial mobilization equipment; ongoing vehicle costs remain operating expenses.; label: Business and technical setup; value: $30,000 reference allocation; 20.0%; numeric value: 30000.0; detail: Lean $20,000; reference $30,000; expanded $70,000. Fund licensing, training, insurance deposits, estimating setup, dispatch configuration, bookkeeping systems, and initial referral development.

rect.title: label: Working-capital reserve; numeric value: 60000.0; value: $60,000 reference allocation; 40.0%; detail: Lean $25,000; reference $60,000; expanded $150,000. Fund receivable delays and job commitments. At $42,500 monthly Base operating costs, $60,000 covers about 1.41 months before variable direct job costs.

label: Mitigation equipment; numeric value: 40000.0; value: $40,000 reference allocation; 26.7%; detail: Lean $20,000; reference $40,000; expanded $90,000. Prioritize extraction, air movement, dehumidification, moisture meters, protective equipment, and calibrated measurement tools; rent overflow capacity.

label: Vehicle and mobilization setup; numeric value: 20000.0; value: $20,000 reference allocation; 13.3%; detail: Lean $10,000; reference $20,000; expanded $40,000. Fund vehicle deposits or acquisitions, secure storage, load restraint, and initial mobilization equipment; ongoing vehicle costs remain operating expenses.

Fund licensing, training, insurance deposits, estimating setup, dispatch configuration, bookkeeping systems, and initial referral development.
